fusions.name: Fletched Stinger
fusions.desc: Fires a sting that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it reaches and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Emptied Quiver
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stings at once, spread apart, each dealing 14 damage and bursting on impact for 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Far Forage
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Barbs Left In
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a barb builds on that enemy, up to 10. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per barb. Unfed, a barb fades every 4 seconds.
